title: In this world, the player steals a car every 30 seconds

tts.note: free local placeholder (ElevenLabs free quota used up); swap to Valf unWb9iRIK7Xxf4A5Hfis via elevenlabs engine when the plan allows

lines.text: In this world, the player steals a car every *30 seconds*.
The pizza guy walks to work. The mayor rides a bike. Nobody here has owned a car for more than a *minute*.
Except my dad. He *never* gives up.
Every morning, he buys a brand new car.
And every morning, the player steals it. Usually before Dad even finds his *keys*.
On day 312, Dad sat on the curb and said, Nico, maybe we're just *NPCs*.
The player only steals *cool* cars. So I built the *ugliest* car in the whole game.
Pink doors. A couch for a seat. And a *toilet* for a horn.
Dad parked it on the street, and we waited.
Nobody stole it. Dad *cried*. Happy tears.
Then the player walked by. He stopped. He stared.
The next morning, *500* players were outside our house.
Taking selfies with the ugliest car in the game.
In this world, the player steals a car every 30 seconds. Except ours. Ours, they line up to *see*.
